column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the temple” is rendered “the sanctuary,” and “the tent” “the tabernacle.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “high” for the six cubits of the entrance.
Close to the Hebrew; “to the face of the temple” is rendered “beyond the sanctuary,” and “the holy place of the holy places” “the Most Holy Place.”
NKJV renders “three and thirty times” as “in three stories … thirty chambers in each story,” and “going into the wall” as “rested on ledges”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
NKJV paraphrases this difficult verse, adding “their supporting ledges … ascended like steps” and “the width of the structure increased”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “the free space” is rendered “the remaining terrace.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the free space” is rendered “the terrace.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the separate place” is rendered “the separating courtyard,” and “the side toward the sea” “its western end.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the closed windows” is rendered “the beveled window frames.”
Close to the Hebrew; “were made” is rendered “were carved.”
Close to the Hebrew; the rare word for a wooden structure on the porch is rendered “A wooden canopy”; its meaning is uncertain.
